data.one_liner: Widget for customizable chat bubbles with multiple clipper styles
data.what_it_does: Provides a ChatBubble widget that can render various chat bubble shapes such as WhatsApp or Telegram styles. It supports customization of color, alignment, margin, padding and child content.
use_when: Building a messaging or chat interface
Need multiple bubble styles without custom drawing
avoid_when: You already have a custom bubble implementation
You need advanced features like message status or typing indicators
strengths: Wide range of pre‑built clipper styles
weaknesses: Limited to bubble UI only, no message list or state management
No built‑in support for avatars or timestamps
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package
data.minimal_example:
ChatBubble(
  clipper: ChatBubbleClipper1(type: BubbleType.sendBubble),
  alignment: Alignment.topRight,
  margin: EdgeInsets.only(top: 20),
  backGroundColor: Colors.blue,
  child: Container(
    constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: MediaQuery.of(context).size.width * 0.7),
    child: Text(
      "Hello world",
      style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
    ),
  ),
)
